---
title: Guanciale Frittatas
id: MAR-0038
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 100 g guanciale, cut into cubes
- 6 eggs
- 1 spring onion
- 1 boiled potato
- 1 dried red chili
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Brown the guanciale cubes in a non-stick pan without fat.
2. Peel the spring onion and cut it into cubes.
3. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the spring onion, the guanciale, the potato cut into cubes, the crumbled chili pepper, and salt.
4. Mix well to combine the ingredients.
5. In a small non-stick pan with a diameter of 13 cm, heat a tablespoon of oil, pour in some of the mixture, and let it set.
6. Turn the frittata using a lid and let it brown on the other side.
7. Cook the other frittatas the same way.
